title: Flash column chromatography
caption: Air pressure pushes the eluent through a column of silica quickly. Less polar compounds spend less time adsorbed on the polar silica and leave first; more polar ones are held back and elute later.
alt: A column of silica with air pressure applied at the top; bands of three compounds separating, the least polar lowest.
description: Least polar compound: lowest band, elutes first.
Most polar: still near the top.
